cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:a86.title: AI Solutions Engineer
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:a86.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs. Reports to: VP, Performance Marketing Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid) preferred
responsibilities: Build and deploy AI tools and automations across brands, including image processing, feed optimization, content generation, reporting, and process streamlining.
Connect software systems and APIs to create integrated workflows that scale across multiple brands with minimal reconfiguration.
Work directly with teams across departments to understand their manual processes and build AI-powered solutions that replicate and improve them.
Write scripts (Python, JavaScript) and design AI workflows using platforms like Claude, ChatGPT, and workflow automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar).
Cross-connect data across platforms including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, Google Merchant Center, content management systems, and image libraries.
Scale proven tools to additional brands by adapting validated solutions for cross-brand deployment.
Train non-technical teams on AI tools and ensure sustained adoption and productivity gains.
Continuously identify high-impact automation opportunities by networking across the organization and prioritizing by ROI.
qualifications: 2-5 years of experience building automations, integrations, or AI-powered tools in a marketing, e-commerce, or operations environment.

Proven experience building autonomous AI agents and architectures, moving beyond standard linear workflows (e.g., n8n, Zapier) to design stateful, dynamic AI systems with memory, or demonstrated experience using LangGraph.
Strong working knowledge of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, etc) nd the ability to design reliable, production-grade agentic workflows, prompts, and tool-calling schemas.
Comfortable writing Python and/or JavaScript to connect APIs, manage data pipelines, handle state, and build lightweight application layers for AI agents.
Experience with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, etc) as a component of broader automated solutions.
Familiarity with digital marketing and e-commerce ecosystems, including platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, or Google Merchant Center.
Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to independently identify business friction, propose agentic solutions, and ship without heavy direction.
Experience with n8n specifically.
Hands-on experience infrastructure tools like MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar agentic frameworks.
Background in retail, DTC, or multi-brand e-commerce environments.
Experience training or onboarding non-technical users on new tools.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:11ae144d-f698-.title: Sr. Corporate Counsel
jobgether-jobgether:lever:11ae144d-f698-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Corporate Counsel based in the United States. This senior legal role provides strategic counsel across global commercial and corporate contracting activities within a fast-growing healthcare technology environment. You will lead the drafting, negotiation, interpretation, and management of a broad portfolio of complex commercial agreements. The position combines sophisticated legal work with practical business partnership, helping leaders identify risks and develop creative, commercially sound solutions. You will collaborate closely with teams across regulatory, finance, R&D, quality, IT, procurement, business development, and other functions. A key part of the role is strengthening contract processes, controls, systems, training, and lifecycle management as the organization expands internationally. The role offers substantial autonomy, visibility with senior decision-makers, and the opportunity to influence how legal operations scale. This is a fully remote U.S. opportunity suited to an experienced commercial attorney who brings sound judgment, strong communication, and a business-oriented mindset. Provide legal and business advice, drafting, negotiation, and interpretation support for a broad range of commercial and operational agreements, including NDAs, software and SaaS agreements, services and consulting agreements, marketing, supply and manufacturing agreements, equipment leases, distribution, collaboration, partnership, development, and clinical trial agreements. Partner directly with key business decision-makers during negotiations, identifying material legal and commercial risks and developing practical mitigation strategies and solutions. Support expanding international operations by proactively identifying legal and business risks and collaborating cross-functionally on appropriate responses. Develop, implement, administer, and continuously improve contract administration processes, systems, procedures, and internal controls. Work with contract administrators to monitor contractual obligations, renewals, expirations, and other key covenants. Strengthen legal-process training and communications to promote consistent and effective contract management practices. Collaborate with regulatory, procurement, R&D, finance, quality, IT, corporate, business development, and other teams to maintain an efficient contract lifecycle and ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. Identify and implement appropriate approval controls for new contractual commitments and support financial advisors and internal audit teams with requested documentation. Manage outside counsel when required and maintain strict confidentiality regarding legal communications and documentation. Help ensure contractual compliance with privacy requirements, including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR, as well as healthcare and medical-device regulations such as EU/UK MDR and FDA requirements. Requirements Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent law degree with excellent academic credentials. Active license to practice law in California, or admission in another U.S. state with eligibility and registration as In-House Counsel in California. 10+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial experience handling complex commercial transactions. Preferably, at least 2 years of in-house legal experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related healthcare industry. Strong and broad knowledge of commercial and contract law, with demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated agreements. Familiarity with the federal False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, and Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act. Working knowledge of general privacy laws and of international, federal, and state requirements applicable to medical-device organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication s

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4e070d60-409b-.title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4e070d60-409b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager based in Austria. This is a commercially focused role for a digital marketing professional who can turn online visibility into measurable revenue growth. You’ll own strategies across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, email marketing, landing pages, and e-commerce optimisation. Your focus will be on generating qualified B2B leads, increasing online sales, and strengthening customer acquisition and retention. You’ll work across diverse customer segments and extensive product catalogues, connecting marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution, experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimisation. It’s an ideal opportunity for an analytical, results-driven professional who wants their work measured by revenue, conversions, and sustainable business growth. Develop and execute an inbound marketing strategy focused on generating qualified B2B enquiries, quote requests, bulk orders, reseller opportunities, account applications, and online sales. Build targeted campaigns and lead-generation funnels for different industries, customer segments, product categories, and purchasing needs. Partner with sales and management teams to track leads from initial enquiry through conversion, improve lead quality, and introduce lead scoring, automated follow-up, and nurturing workflows. Own the organic search strategy across SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation, and Generative Engine Optimisation, including keyword research, competitor analysis, technical optimisation, structured data, internal linking, content architecture, and search-intent analysis. Optimise product, category, service, and location-based pages to improve rankings and visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Develop commercially focused content around pricing, bulk purchasing, product comparisons, specifications, delivery information, and frequently asked questions. Create and optimise high-converting landing pages for retail, wholesale, reseller, corporate, and government audiences. Improve calls to action, forms, account applications, checkout journeys, and other conversion points through testing and behavioural analysis. Manage and optimise the e-commerce platform, including product information, descriptions, specifications, imagery, category structures, pricing, stock information, promotions, and customer journeys. Develop strategies to increase average order value, purchase frequency, and repeat revenue through bundles, volume offers, cross-selling, upselling, promotions, and abandoned-cart recovery. Plan, launch, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing, display, and relevant Meta or LinkedIn channels. Manage advertising budgets and continuously improve cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend. Build segmented email marketing and automated lifecycle campaigns covering new enquiries, quote follow-ups, abandoned carts, account applications, repeat-order reminders, customer reactivation, product launches, and promotions. Analyse campaign, CRM, website, and sales data to identify which marketing activities generate customers and revenue rather than relying on vanity metrics. Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards covering leads, quote requests, e-commerce sales, conversion rates, organic performance, advertising efficiency, average order value, repeat purchasing, and marketing-attributed revenue. Identify priority products, customer segments, and growth opportunities in collaboration with sales and management teams. Continuously test, measure, and refine marketing initiatives to improve commercial performance and establish clear attribution between digital activity and revenue. Requi

jobgether-jobgether:lever:909f5d8f-c71c-.title: AI/ML Engineer — Agentic AI Systems
jobgether-jobgether:lever:909f5d8f-c71c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer — Agentic AI Systems based in Canada. This is a hands-on engineering opportunity focused on building intelligent, reliable systems that automate complex IT operations. You will work at the intersection of applied machine learning, agentic AI, distributed systems, and production software engineering. Your work will enable AI agents to interpret operational signals, coordinate actions across multiple platforms, and make decisions safely in real-world environments. You will design behavioral anomaly detection capabilities and build evaluation frameworks to measure model quality, reliability, latency, and safety. The role involves turning relevant ML and systems research into practical, production-ready implementations. You will collaborate closely with platform, security, and product teams to establish guardrails, permissions, monitoring, fallbacks, and auditability. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI platform where intelligent automation operates at enterprise scale. Build agentic AI workflows capable of interpreting PSA and RMM signals, coordinating vendor API calls, and supporting automated decision-making across customer environments. Develop behavioral anomaly detection models using workflow activity, credential usage, tool-call sequences, and cross-platform interaction patterns. Implement detection mechanisms for scope escalation, abnormal decision paths, unexpected tool usage, and unusual output volumes. Build evaluation harnesses and benchmarking pipelines to assess model and agent behavior, quality, latency, reliability, and safety. Translate relevant machine learning and systems research into tested, maintainable production implementations. Contribute to OpenAPI-based connector generation and integration workflows across IT management, security, and MSP platforms. Integrate AI workloads with durable execution systems to support retries, partial failures, recovery, and long-running workflows. Partner with platform, security, and product teams to implement monitoring, fallbacks, permissions, guardrails, and auditability for AI-powered capabilities. Help improve the reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness of AI systems running in production environments. Requirements Experience developing and operating production AI or machine learning systems using Python or a comparable programming language. Hands-on experience building LLM or agent workflows with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or a similar orchestration framework. Experience integrating model providers such as Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex AI, or comparable platforms into production applications. Experience developing evaluation harnesses, benchmark pipelines, automated tests, or other mechanisms for assessing model and agent behavior. Demonstrated ability to apply machine learning or systems research techniques to production software. Experience with behavioral anomaly detection, time-series analysis, statistical baselining, or outlier detection is an advantage. Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka is preferred. Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow orchestration platform is a plus. Knowledge of ClickHouse or another columnar data store used for analytical workloads is beneficial. Experience with API integrations, OpenAPI tooling, connector-generation pipelines, workflow automation, or enterprise security technologies is advantageous. Familiarity with MSP tooling, IT operations platforms, or security products is a strong plus. Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into reliable production solutions. Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, platform, security, and product teams in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Competitive base salary of CAD $160,000–$240,000 per

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b0ca8353-eabc-.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b0ca8353-eabc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Data) based in Brazil. This is an opportunity to join a lean, autonomous engineering team building products that help organizations better understand and optimize cloud data costs. You’ll play a key role in designing and delivering new capabilities across backend systems, data engineering, visualization, and cost-management workflows. The position offers meaningful ownership, with the opportunity to shape technical direction and influence the product roadmap. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers and founding team members in a fast-moving environment where pragmatic decisions and customer impact matter. From data pipelines and transformation models to resilient application components, your work will directly improve the product experience. The role is ideal for a self-directed engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, moving quickly, and owning features from concept through release. You’ll also have the flexibility and autonomy of a distributed team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and sustainable ways of working. Design and build new product capabilities focused on data cost management, including forecasting, anomaly detection, cost allocation, and related workflows. Develop reliable and reusable backend and data-engineering solutions that surface actionable insights for customers. Build data pipelines and transformation models that support new product capabilities and identify opportunities for optimization. Create and improve data visualization features that communicate performance, query timing, efficiency, and other important metrics clearly. Develop resilient, reusable UI components that contribute to a smooth and intuitive product experience. Improve application reliability, scalability, and performance through thoughtful engineering practices and system design. Own features end to end, from identifying problems and shaping requirements through technical design, implementation, testing, and release. Evaluate technical and product tradeoffs to prioritize high-impact solutions and deliver meaningful customer value efficiently. Collaborate closely with engineers and senior stakeholders through clear proposals, documentation, code reviews, testing, and effective communication. Contribute to a culture of pragmatic execution, continuous improvement, and strong engineering quality. Requirements 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong expertise in backend development and data engineering. Strong working knowledge of Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, dbt, Dagster, and Snowflake . Solid understanding of system design and the ability to develop scalable, reliable technical solutions. Experience building data pipelines, transformation workflows, backend services, and data-driven product capabilities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed environment. Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain accountable for outcomes from initial concept through delivery. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment when balancing speed, technical depth, and customer impact. Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment where priorities and requirements may change. Strong collaboration skills and a commitment to readable, maintainable code, clear documentation, and thorough testing. A proactive, curious, and positive approach to engineering, with genuine enthusiasm for solving challenging problems. Familiarity with FinOps, cloud infrastructure cost management, data-warehouse management, or observability is a plus. Previous experience working in an early-stage startup or similarly lean engineering environment is advantageous. Benefits Base salary of up to $180,000 CAD , plus additional compensation opportun
